functions.label: Mobilisation
functions.definition: Activating people and resources in response to a demand.

episodes.title: Improving milk quality without a price premium
episodes.demand: Improve milk quality and production practices.
episodes.reportedResponse: The report describes better practices and milk quality, without a higher sale price; no quality standard had been negotiated with the buyer.
episodes.reportedContinuity: Practical knowledge was taken up. The report identifies missing records, production planning and a sustainable financing mechanism for the promoter.

functionalReadings.interpretation: Technical knowledge is brought into local production practices. Transfer is described; the extent of two-way recombination is an analytical question.
The episode exposes the missing articulation between production improvement, regular supply and buyer agreements.

evidence.quote: Mejoró la calidad de la leche.
La mejora en calidad de la leche no se reflejó en aumento del precio de venta: no existe un estándar negociado con el comprador

episodes.title: Using a revolving fund for inputs and transport
episodes.demand: Access productive finance beyond conventional credit barriers.
episodes.reportedResponse: The report describes continued financing of inputs. ASITAPUR also acquired a cargo vehicle through the revolving fund.
episodes.reportedContinuity: The fund is reused. Repayment timing, selection criteria and standardized records remain issues reported by participants.

functionalReadings.interpretation: Associations mobilize shared financial resources for productive needs.
Loan allocation, repayment and reinvestment require aligned commitments.
Collectively administered access to resources is read through mutual support; this is not evidence of every interpersonal support tie.

evidence.quote: ASITAPUR adquirió un motocarguero para el transporte de productos con recursos del fondo rotatorio, lo que muestra cómo el mecanismo trasciende los insumos y empieza a responder a necesidades de logística e infraestructura productiva.
Los tiempos y plazos no están alineados con el ciclo de cosecha de los productores(as), dificultando los pagos

episodes.title: Aggregating demand for agricultural inputs
episodes.demand: Reduce input costs and improve access to reliable supplies.
episodes.reportedResponse: The report describes lower purchasing costs and improved access to input quality, alongside gaps in quantity planning and technical information.
episodes.reportedContinuity: Participants propose permanent purchasing alliances, distribution logistics and connections to processing and commercialization.

functionalReadings.interpretation: Producers bring needs and resources into a shared purchase.
Demand aggregation, negotiation and distribution connect participants in interdependent tasks.
Missing soil studies and crop-specific information reveal a knowledge-integration demand.

evidence.quote: El Prototipo permitió articular a los y las productoras para identificar necesidades comunes, consolidar compras, negociar mejores precios, distribuir insumos entre asociados y generar economías de escala.
La planificación de compras no es óptima: falta considerar los productos requeridos y las cantidades según el tamaño del cultivo

episodes.title: Assembling community tourism routes
episodes.demand: Turn dispersed experiences into an organized tourism offer.
episodes.reportedResponse: Routes bring together experiences, and the report describes narratives and costing tools developed for a minimum viable offer.
episodes.reportedContinuity: Marketing, commercial portfolios, infrastructure and institutional articulation remain unfinished aspects.

functionalReadings.interpretation: Local experience providers are brought around a shared offer.
Nature, culture, gastronomy and local history are combined in route design.
An integrated route requires aligned services and costs; this reading connects initiative design and reported work.

evidence.quote: La existencia de atractivos dispersos y experiencias comunitarias aisladas que no lograban consolidarse como una oferta turística organizada y comercializable.
Se diseñaron narrativas y herramientas prácticas para definir la estructura de costos y lograr un Producto Mínimo Viable Funcional (PMVF).

episodes.title: Maintaining a shared digital tourism presence
episodes.demand: Connect dispersed tourism information and local offers to visitors.
episodes.reportedResponse: The report describes a valued digital directory and information platform; it also identifies no dedicated content team and missing booking/payment systems.
episodes.reportedContinuity: Participants propose content partnerships and a wider promotion ecosystem. These proposals are not completed actions.

functionalReadings.interpretation: Collecting local stories and service information creates a shared representation of the territory.
Maintaining content, promotion and commercial channels requires recurrent coordination across providers.

evidence.quote: La dispersión de la información turística y la baja visibilidad digital de la oferta local, dificultando que visitantes encontraran servicios, experiencias y atractivos del territorio.
Ausencia de un equipo dedicado exclusivamente a la creación de contenidos

episodes.title: Connecting local food, identity and tourism
episodes.demand: Make local food products visible and connect producers, processors and tourism experiences.
episodes.reportedResponse: The report recognizes accumulated gastronomic knowledge and community food-service experience, while describing transport, equipment and commercial organization gaps.
episodes.reportedContinuity: Integration with routes, festivals and promotion channels is proposed. The source does not establish that every proposed connection is already operating.

functionalReadings.interpretation: Food traditions, product knowledge and cultural storytelling are potential complementary contributions.
The demand spans producers, processors, transport and tourism channels; a complete configuration is not documented.

evidence.quote: La baja visibilidad y aprovechamiento económico de la gastronomía local como activo turístico y cultural, así como la desconexión entre productores(as), transformadores y experiencias turísticas
Experiencia acumulada en prestación de servicios alimentarios comunitarios

episodes.title: Learning from an underprepared buyer meeting
episodes.demand: Present a credible supply offer to prospective buyers.
episodes.reportedResponse: The report recounts an earlier business meeting where potential suppliers arrived without samples or commercial portfolios.
episodes.reportedContinuity: Participants propose preparation around buyer requirements, samples, offer definition and follow-up.

functionalReadings.interpretation: A meeting brings parties into contact; it is one component of the response.
Buyer requirements and supplier capabilities need to be brought together before the meeting.
Samples, portfolios, commitments and follow-up require organization across participants.

evidence.quote: en la rueda de diciembre los posibles proveedores no llevaron muestras ni portafolios

episodes.title: Coordinating a territorial agroenterprise agenda
episodes.demand: Connect institutions and producer organizations around shared commercial and productive challenges.
episodes.reportedResponse: The report describes deliberation about the Mesa purpose, working agendas and concrete commercial, technical and organizational gaps.
episodes.reportedContinuity: Meeting schedules and continuous task follow-up were proposed. Source associations identify participants at programme level, not attendance at every meeting.

functionalReadings.interpretation: The Mesa convenes actors from different sectors.
Commercial, technical and territorial perspectives meet in a common forum.
Participants work on shared priorities and arrangements for following up commitments.

evidence.quote: El diálogo en la dimensión de gobernanza permitió construir una visión compartida sobre el propósito y la estructura óptima de la Mesa.
con seguimiento continuo a tareas y compromisos.
